class.name: NNActionStateTreeEvent
class.brief_description: An action that fires a state tree event and finishes immediately.
class.description: Sends [member event_name] to an [NNSTRoot] when this action starts, then finishes right away. Use this inside an [NNBehaviour] when you want a utility AI decision to trigger a transition in a state tree without writing a script. Leave [member state_tree_path] empty to target the nearest ancestor [NNSTRoot] (for example, when an [NNAgent] is hosted inside a state).

members.member: Name of the event sent to the target [NNSTRoot] when this action starts.
Path to the target [NNSTRoot]. Leave empty to target the nearest ancestor [NNSTRoot].
